parameters.help_en:

Valid values:

false
true
parameters.help_zh: （已弃用）是否开启实例的容灾状态
parameters.name: disable_replication

parameters.help_en: The description of the instance. The instance description must be 3 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 实例描述。长度限制在3-256个字符之间
parameters.name: instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. Instance naming conventions:

The name can contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
The name must start with a letter.
The name cannot end with a hyphen (-).
The name is case-insensitive.
The name must be 3 to 16 characters in length.
The name cannot contain the following words: ali, ay, ots, taobao, and admin
parameters.help_zh:
实例名称。实例的命名规范如下：
必须由英文字母、数字或短划线（-）组成。
首字符必须为英文字母。
末尾字符不能为短划线（-）。
大小写不敏感。
长度在3~16字符之间。
实例名称不能包含ali、ay、ots、taobao、admin这几个单词
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: (Deprecated) The network type of the instance. Valid values: NORMAL and VPC_CONSOLE. Default value: NORMAL
parameters.help_zh: （已弃用）实例网络类型。NORMAL, VPC_CONSOLE。默认为NORMAL
parameters.name: network

parameters.help_en:
The types of the source from which access is allowed. By default, the following source type is allowed:

TRUST_PROXY: console
parameters.help_zh:
实例允许的网络来源列表，默认都允许。

TRUST_PROXY：可信网关（控制台）
parameters.name: network_source_acl

parameters.help_en:
The types of the network from which access is allowed. By default, the following network types are allowed:

INTERNET: Internet
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
CLASSIC: classic network
parameters.help_zh:
实例允许的网络类型列表，默认都允许。
INTERNET：公网。
VPC：VPC网络。
CLASSIC：经典网
parameters.name: network_type_acl

parameters.help_en: The instance policy in the JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 实例访问控制策略，JSON格式
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs
